steps.title: Submit notification of move
steps.detail: You must submit a notification of move to both Posti and the Population Information System when you move.
steps.due: at the latest one week after the move

steps.title: Apply for municipality of residence registration
steps.detail: If you have a Finnish personal identity code and intend to stay in Finland for more than a year, you must apply to register your municipality of residence and visit a DVV service location in person.
steps.due: within one month of sending the form

steps.title: Apply for Kela benefits after moving to Tampere
steps.detail: If you do not live in Finland permanently, you can qualify for Kela benefits if you work in Finland and earn at least this amount.

steps.title: Notify Kela of your move to Tampere
steps.detail: You need to notify Kela that you have moved to Finland by submitting a notification in the OmaKela e-service.

steps.title: Apply for general housing allowance if needed
steps.detail: If your income is low, you can apply for general housing allowance through the OmaKela service or on a form.

steps.title: Apply for a residence permit (if required)
steps.detail: If you are a citizen of a country outside the Nordic countries, EU, Liechtenstein, or Switzerland, you must apply for a residence permit from the Finnish Immigration Service before moving.

steps.title: Apply for a Finnish ID card
steps.detail: Once you have a personal identity number from DVV, you can apply for a Finnish ID card at a police station.

steps.title: Submit notification of move to DVV
steps.detail: You must submit a notification of move to the Digital and Population Data Services Agency. This can be done online or via a paper form at service locations.

steps.title: Give notice on current rental dwelling
steps.detail: If you are currently living in a rental apartment, notify your landlord of your departure, generally observing one month's notice.

steps.title: Notify your building manager
steps.detail: If you are moving from a block of flats or terraced house, you must inform the property manager of your move.

steps.title: Apply for general housing allowance
steps.detail: General housing allowance is available for rental apartments and is calculated based on household size and location. You must pay at least 30 percent of your housing costs yourself.
